description:
Inkwell gives you a thoughtful journaling prompt each day and helps you reflect on what you wrote.

AI reflections are generated by a third-party AI provider. Inkwell asks for your permission before any entry is shared, and you can turn reflections off at any time.

Inkwell Plus is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://inkwell.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://inkwell.app/privacy
promotionalText: New this month: gratitude prompts and community prompt packs.
whatsNew: Community prompt packs, plus reporting and blocking tools.
